title: Knowledge Index
caption: Index
text:
<$ss.hero title="Knowledge Index" subtitle="A central hub organizing topics with responsive cards"/> <$ss.grid min="260px"> <$list filter="[all[tiddlers]tag[Topic]!has[draft.of]sort[title]]"> <$ss.card badge={{!!category}} accent="var(--tpc-primary)">

<$link to={{!!title}}><$text text={{!!title}}/>

<$transclude field="description" mode="inline"/>

title: Reading & Research Hub
caption: Reading
text:
<$ss.hero title="Reading & Research" subtitle="Track articles, books, and reference material"/> <$ss.grid min="280px"> <$list filter="[all[tiddlers]tag[Reading]!has[draft.of]!sort[modified]]"> <$ss.card badge={{!!status}} accent={{!!color}}>

<$link to={{!!title}}><$text text={{!!title}}/>

<$ss.progress value={{!!progress}} total="100" label={{!!status}}/>

title: Task & Project Tracker
caption: Tasks
text:
<$ss.hero title="Task Overview" subtitle="A lightweight task tracker built with standard tags and cards"/> <$ss.grid min="240px"> <$list filter="[all[tiddlers]tag[Task]!tag[Done]sort[priority]]"> <$ss.card badge={{!!priority}} accent={{!!accent}}> <$checkbox tag="Done"> ''<$link to={{!!title}}><$text text={{!!title}}/>''
<$text text={{!!description}}/>
